between security, functionality, safety and system performance.</li> <li>Communicating technical findings clearly to engineers, project teams and customers.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Domains and project post-quantum cryptography.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>What you can bring</strong></h3> <p><strong>The below is essential</strong></p> <ul data-spread="false"> <li>An excellent degree or PhD placement year or relevant postgraduate experience.</li> <li>A good understanding of fundamental engineering, computing or security principles.</li> <li>Practical experience through university, science</li> <li>systems engineering</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <ul data-spread="false"> <li>The ability to understand and analyse technical systems and identify risks or weaknesses.</li> <li>Some <li>Clear communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with others.</li> </ul> <p><strong>The below is advantageous, but isn’t essential</strong></p> <ul data-spread="false">
